all_quotes.quote: However, as the observing frequency increases, the flux densities of most QSOs diminish, and the system noise temperature rises. This indicates that fewer bright-enough phase calibrators are available close to targets at arbitrary sky positions.

all_quotes.quote: a temporal overhead of ∼ 20 s takes place for every frequency switching event that requires a retuning of the photonic local oscillator (LO) signal (cite: Shillue2012). This hinders the fast switching and essentially makes 20 s switching cycle times with frequency switching impossible.

all_quotes.loc: 4.1 Stage 2: DGC solution stability
all_quotes.quote: From the stage 2 test, we found that the DGC is satisfactorily stable, i.e. there are no rapid instrumental variations, excluding obvious problematic antennas.

all_quotes.loc: 4.3.2 Complex structure target I: HL Tau in Band 9–4
all_quotes.quote: We evaluated the image fidelity of our Band 9 data by comparison with the long baseline SV in Band 7 in LBC-2014

all_quotes.loc: 4.3.2 Complex structure target I: HL Tau in Band 9–4
all_quotes.quote: Furthermore, due to the relatively short on-source time and the handful of short baselines, the poor (u, v) sampling of the largely extended disk structure causes a striped side-lobe pattern throughout our Band 9 image at the 50%–60% level with natural weighting.

all_quotes.loc: 3 Strategy of HF-LBC-2017
all_quotes.quote: Although spectral regions with a relatively large dispersive term were used in Bands 8 and 10, we adopted the simple frequency scaling ratio for B2B phase referencing because other comparable delay errors, such as the antenna position errors, do not have a frequency dependence.

all_quotes.loc: 6 Summary
all_quotes.quote: Another important subject not fully investigated for HFs is where the dispersive term of the atmospheric water vapor is greater than a few tens of percent.
